name: Moolooite Mines
description: This ghost mine is one of the places the dwarves avoid the most. All of its workers died tragically and were cursed to remain within the mines indefinitely. In the Ethereal Plane, they have established a village inside and continue to mine ores that are unique to that plane. They also have a forge there and create ethereal weapons and armor. On the Material Plane, these ethereal items cannot be obtained. However, it has caught the interest of certain necromancers who frequently traverse that plane and some priests from the Kepesh, who aim to use the ethereal ores for their spells and to construct the Eternal City for their deity Ba-Ka. Though it is sealed and difficult to access, some adventurers are still hired to explore it, as the dwarves believe this mine has many valuable metals.
